verdict.rationale: Copilot's agent mode documents editing files across the workspace, and the desktop workspace lets a user launch and track work across multiple agents in parallel, which loosely approximates acting on many items at once. Nothing explicitly documents batch or bulk operations, such as applying one change across many issues, PRs, or repos in a single action. Scheduled and event-driven automations are recurring triggers, not bulk actions, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk or batch operations across many items, scope and limits of multi-item actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
